author: Saikron
body:
First, You said that your excuse for the "Nova" comments was that you guys were talking to Nova on another teamspeak. This is impossible as your mics would have been disabled on the other teamspeak.

Nova was on avicus teamspeak if you don`t noticed, is not my problem if you dont noticed him.

Second, Nova was "stratting maps", but how does he strat maps without looking at them.

"Do".. lol not "do", should I know how? Maybe he had it? Prodigys server had some of them, so posibly he looked them there ( i guess why and how could i know lol ).

 It was stated that "Nova isn't here so I strat" - I being Besq. This obviously means Nova would have to be online to see the maps for him to create strats. This shows that Nova has connections with an account for ban evasion.

Ask nova, not me, I don`t know if he had the maps or not, he just said to us that he had a list of all map`s strats & positions for each player, as I said, ask nova or scaglia. Besta said that because nova was afk ( as he didnt talked when we ask to ) so besta created the strat, ( then when we finished nova said that he was back ).

Third, I still don't understand why you lied about the mic. At first, you said that you didn't have a mic. Next time, you said it was broken, so you did have a mic.

OK, lets think something. If you have a mic, but cant use it, is there a difference that if you dont have a mic?
BROKEN MIC -> cant use
NO MIC -> cant use
Difference?
The only difference I see is that with a broken mic you can make "static" as you called it.

Fourth, even if Nova was not ban evading on your account, EC would still have to face the penalties as Nova was on another teamspeak assisting you guys in the tournament. This goes against the tournament rules. There could have also been many options that can be considered as having an unfair advantage, such as a player livestreaming and nova watching it and providing you guys with strats.

As I said, Scaglia was on our teamspeak hearing nova, and he heard he just give us the strat and go on, you can ask him, hes your ref, as I said.

there refs for something, you canb ask Scaglia, as he was our ref, Point 1, 2 and 4 can be clarified if you ask the ref, is that difficult?


pd: sorry for bad english some things with google translator

gl

replies.body:
Hello,

"Nova was on an alternative ts, and he said the strats for each maps, but at the first match with cronus ( i think ) and he was not there (i dont know why) so Besta created the "strat". nova was just saying us the strat he created for each map"

You said that he was on an alternate teamspeak on your other appeal.

Also, you said that you used the mic on your mom's iphone headphones. But the mic on that doesn't work on computers.

Anyways, you've been changing your stories for each argument multiple times.

You may create another appeal regarding this situation in 6-8 months as it is currently denied.
If you create anymore appeals following this, you may get a temp forum ban.

Regards,
Neyke
